home.tagline: A companion for every season of becoming a mother.
home.lede: A calendar and a daily companion for your cycle, trying for a baby, pregnancy, the newborn months and menopause. Your days stay on your phone.
home.heroAlt: A painting of a pregnant woman holding her belly
home.ch.title: Five chapters, one companion
home.ch.lede: Choose where you are, and Bloom shapes itself around it. Move to the next chapter whenever life does.
home.ch.cycle: Your period, the days around it, your mood and body. Bloom learns your rhythm from what you log and shows what is coming.
home.ch.ttc: Your morning temperature, ovulation tests and fluid move your fertile window, and Bloom says which sign it rests on — and when a pregnancy test can tell.
home.ch.pregnant: Week by week: how your baby is growing, painted; your appointments; kicks and contractions when the time comes.
home.ch.newborn: Feeds, sleep and diapers in one tap — even at 3am. Pumping by side, and the milk you have in the fridge and the freezer.
home.ch.peri: Symptoms, hot flushes and cycle changes over time, so you can see your own pattern — and bring it to your doctor.
home.ch.loss: If a pregnancy ends, Bloom has a quiet space that pauses everything, for as long as you need.
home.ask.lede: Write to Bloom, or call her and talk. She answers in plain words, remembers what you have told her, and says when something needs your doctor or midwife.
home.ask.t1: Questions any hour, in five languages.
home.ask.t2: A voice call when typing is too much — at 3am, with a baby on your arm.
home.ask.t3: She remembers what you share, so you don't start from nothing each time.
ask.flow: To answer, your question goes through Bloom's own server to Anthropic; a call goes straight from your phone to OpenAI. What is sent, and why.
home.ask.shotAlt: Ask Bloom in the app: a question about the baby's movements and Bloom's answer
home.fam.title: Bring your family in
home.fam.lede: Bloom is yours, and your people can be part of it.
home.fam.t1: Your circle — the people you choose, in one place.
home.fam.t2: The baby pool — everyone guesses the day and the weight.
home.fam.t3: Letters — words for your baby, sealed until the day you choose.
home.fam.t4: Your book — the journey, kept as a keepsake.
home.fam.fine: You decide what you share, and with whom.
home.fam.shotAlt: Us in the app: the circle and the baby pool with the family's guesses
home.priv.title: Private by design
home.priv.t1: Your days stay on your phone. There is no account to make.
home.priv.t2: No ads, no tracking, nothing sold — ever.
home.priv.t3: Only what a feature needs leaves your phone: your question when you ask Bloom, a call's audio when you call her, and a copy of what she remembers if you turn the backup on.
home.priv.t4: Export or delete everything from the app: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.privacy}}.

home.pro.p: Bloom is free to use. Pro adds the full week-by-week journey, the kick counter and the contraction timer — and the Pro tools that come later, with no subscription.
home.pro.fine: You buy Pro once in the App Store or Google Play; the store shows what it costs where you live.

sup.faq.title: Common questions
faq.free.a: Yes. Bloom is free to use. Pro is one payment in the store, for the full week-by-week journey, the kick counter and the contraction timer. There is no subscription.
faq.data.a: On your phone. What you log stays there. Only what a feature needs leaves it: your question when you ask Bloom, a call's audio when you call her, and a copy of what she remembers if you turn the memory backup on. What leaves your phone.
faq.export.q: How do I export or delete my data?
faq.export.a: In the app: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.privacy}}. {{app:privacy.export}} saves everything as a file; {{app:privacy.delete}} removes it from your phone; {{app:privacy.aiforget}} clears her memory, here and in the backup. For anything kept on Bloom's server, write to us.
faq.medical.q: Is Bloom a medical device, or birth control?
faq.medical.a: No, and no. Bloom gives general information and helps you keep track; it does not diagnose or treat. Bloom is not birth control: the fertile window is an estimate and must not be used to prevent a pregnancy. {{warn.askDoctor}} {{warn.emergency}}
faq.phones.q: Which phones does Bloom run on?
faq.phones.a: iPhone with iOS 16.4 or later, and phones with Google Play.
faq.pro.a: You buy Pro once, in the App Store or Google Play, and the store takes the payment — Bloom never sees your card. If you reinstall Bloom and Pro does not come back by itself, write to us with the store's receipt and we will put it right.
faq.ai.q: What happens when I ask Bloom or call her?
faq.ai.a: Your question, with a short note of where you are (your chapter, your week or day), goes through Bloom's own server to Anthropic, which writes the answer. A call goes straight from your phone to OpenAI, which runs Bloom's voice. Nothing is used for ads, and Bloom's server keeps no copy of your questions. The details.
faq.invite.a: In the app, {{app:nav.us}} → {{app:menu.invite}} gives you a code and a link to send. A friend who already has Bloom enters the code in the same place, under {{app:invite.have}}
faq.wrong.q: Bloom said something wrong — what do I do?
faq.wrong.a: Tell us. Choose {{type.bug}} or {{type.feedback}} above and write what you asked and what Bloom said. Bloom can be wrong; your doctor or midwife has the last word.

sup.rate.p: A few words in the store help other women find Bloom.

sum.title: Privacy, in short
sum.lede: What stays on your phone, what leaves it, who receives it, and your choices.
sum.applies: This is a summary. The full privacy policy and the terms are in English, and the English text applies.
sum.who.title: Who we are
sum.who: Bloom is made by Roman Franta, an independent developer in Singapore. Contact: support@bloomdays.family.
sum.short.title: The short version
sum.short.1: What you log stays on your phone. There is no account to make.
sum.short.2: Only what a feature needs leaves your phone: your question when you ask Bloom, a call when you call her, and a copy of her memory if you turn the backup on.
sum.short.3: No ads. No tracking. Nothing is sold, ever.
sum.short.4: You can export or delete everything from the app, at any time.
sum.leaves.title: What leaves your phone, and why
sum.leaves.lede: Bloom has a small server of its own (on Cloudflare). Data leaves your phone only for the features below, only when you use them, and only to make them work.
sum.r1.what: Your question, with a short note of where you are (your chapter and week or your baby's age, your due date, today's logs and symptoms, while trying your signs and fertile window, your medicines, a pregnancy loss if there was one, your next appointment, the names you have told Bloom) and what Bloom remembers of you
sum.r1.who: Bloom's server passes it to Anthropic, which writes the answer (and sometimes searches the web for it)
sum.r1.long: Bloom's server keeps no copy; Anthropic's terms are in the English policy
sum.r2.what: Your voice and Bloom's during a call, and the words of the call
sum.r2.who: Bloom's server sets the call up and gives OpenAI the same short note; the call itself goes straight from your phone to OpenAI. Every few seconds what was just said goes through Bloom's server to Anthropic, to get answers ready and to recognise a voice by name
sum.r2.long: Bloom's server keeps no copy; OpenAI's and Anthropic's terms are in the English policy
sum.r3.when: After a chat or a call
sum.r3.who: Anthropic writes a short dated note of it for Bloom's memory, which comes back to your phone
sum.r3.long: The note lives on your phone only
sum.r4.what: A copy of what Bloom remembers (who you are, people and facts, past moments — not the dated notes)
sum.r4.long: Until you turn the backup off or tap {{app:privacy.aiforget}}
sum.r5.what: A random app ID made on your phone (no name, no email)
sum.r5.long: With your allowance, invites and backup; deleted on request
sum.r6.what: Your free Ask Bloom allowance, and invite codes (no names)
sum.r6.when: When you ask, invite or use a code
sum.r6.long: While you use Bloom; deleted on request
sum.r7.what: That you bought Pro, and when
sum.r7.who: Apple or Google take the payment; RevenueCat tells Bloom that Pro is yours
sum.r7.long: By their policies; Bloom never sees your card
sum.r8.what: Technical connection data (your IP address, the time)
sum.r8.who: Cloudflare, which runs Bloom's server, to deliver and protect it; Bloom's server also counts invite requests by IP address to limit abuse
sum.r8.long: Cloudflare's short logs; the counters are cleared regularly
sum.r9.when: If you tap the microphone instead of typing
sum.r9.who: Your phone's own speech recognition (Apple's or Google's) turns it into text; Bloom sends the text as a question
sum.r10.what: Your email address and your message
sum.r10.when: When you write to us or send the support form
sum.r10.who: Us; a form message goes through Bloom's small sender on Cloudflare and is delivered by Resend
sum.r10.long: Bloom keeps it only to answer you; Resend keeps delivery records
sum.hc: If you connect Health Connect (on phones with Google Play), Bloom reads your temperature, weight, resting heart rate and sleep from it onto your phone. It writes nothing back and sends none of it anywhere except in the short note with a question.
sum.choices.title: Your choices
sum.choices.forget: Forget what Bloom has learned, on your phone and in the backup: {{app:privacy.aiforget}}.
sum.choices.voices: Forget a voice, or all of them: {{app:voices.row}}.
sum.choices.backup: Turn the memory backup off, or never use Ask Bloom or calls — everything else in Bloom works without them.
sum.choices.write: Ask us to see, correct or delete anything kept on Bloom's server: write to support@bloomdays.family. We answer within 30 days.
sum.hd.title: Consumer health data
sum.hd.1: The health data Bloom handles is what the table describes: your chapter, week of pregnancy and due date, your symptoms and logs, while trying your signs and fertile window, your medicines, a pregnancy loss, your baby's age and feeds, your voice in a call, your questions, and the memory backup if you turn it on.
sum.hd.2: It is used only for answers, calls and Bloom's memory, shared only with Anthropic, OpenAI and Cloudflare to make those work, and never sold. The full section (in English)
sum.ads.title: No ads, no tracking
sum.ads: No ads. No tracking. No selling or sharing for advertising. No analytics or crash reporting in the app.
sum.children: Bloom is made for adults and is not for anyone under 16.
sum.contact: Roman Franta, Bloom · support@bloomdays.family · Bloom is general information, not medical advice, not a medical device and not birth control.
page.guide.title: How Bloom works — the guide
page.guide.desc: Find your way around Bloom: what each part of the app does for you, where it is, and how to use it — with real screens of the app.
guide.title: How Bloom works
guide.lede: What each part of Bloom does for you, where to find it, and how to use it — with the app's own words and screens.
guide.more: Something here is not what you see in the app, or you are stuck? Write to us — a person reads it.
guide.start.title: First steps
guide.start.for: Bloom shapes itself around where you are — your cycle, trying, pregnancy, the newborn months or menopause. You choose once, and move on whenever life does.
guide.start.step1: Open Bloom and tap {{app:onb.welcome.begin}}. Choose the chapter you are in, then answer a few short questions.
guide.start.step2: The bar at the bottom: {{app:nav.today}} is your day, {{app:nav.journey}} the weeks and months, {{app:nav.us}} your people, {{app:nav.me}} your settings.
guide.start.step3: The round + in the middle of the bar ({{app:nav.plus}}) logs anything, wherever you are. The button at the top right opens Bloom herself ({{app:orb.label}}).
guide.start.step4: To move to another chapter: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:me.chapter.row}}, and choose. What you have logged comes with you.
guide.start.step5: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.language}} changes Bloom's language; {{app:menu.notifications}} sets a gentle reminder.
guide.start.step6: If you need Bloom to go quiet — after a loss, or for any reason — {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.pause}} → {{app:pause.cta}}. Nothing is deleted, and you come back when you are ready.
guide.start.shotAlt: Bloom's first screen: choosing your chapter, from tracking your cycle to menopause
guide.cycle.title: {{app:mode.cycle}}
guide.cycle.for: Know where you are in your cycle and what is coming. Bloom learns your rhythm from the periods you log and shows the days ahead.
guide.cycle.step1: When your period starts, tap + and choose {{app:cyc.log.start}}.
guide.cycle.step2: Log how you feel the same way: {{app:log.tile.mood}} and {{app:plus.symptoms}}.
guide.cycle.step3: {{app:nav.today}} shows the day of your cycle, its phase — for example {{app:cyc.phase.fertile}} — and when your next period is likely.
guide.cycle.shotAlt: Today in the cycle chapter: the day of the cycle, the phase and what Bloom expects next
guide.trying.title: {{app:mode.ttc}}
guide.trying.for: Your signs — morning temperature, ovulation tests, fluid — move your fertile window, and Bloom says which sign it rests on.
guide.trying.step1: Each morning, tap + → {{app:plus.bbt}} and set your temperature.
guide.trying.step2: Log an {{app:plus.opk}} and your {{app:plus.fluid}} the same way — and {{app:plus.sex}}, if you like.
guide.trying.step3: {{app:nav.today}} shows your fertile window day by day; it moves with what you log.
guide.trying.step4: When you take a pregnancy test, log it: + → {{app:plus.ptest}}.
guide.trying.good: The fertile window is an estimate. Bloom is not birth control and not a medical device.
guide.trying.shotAlt: Today while trying: the fertile window and today's signs
guide.pregnant.title: {{app:mode.pregnant}}
guide.pregnant.for: Week by week: how your baby is growing, what this week brings, your appointments — and the kick counter and contraction timer when the time comes.
guide.pregnant.step1: {{app:nav.today}} shows your week and how your baby is growing; {{app:nav.journey}} goes week by week.
guide.pregnant.step2: To count movements, tap {{app:now.kicks.none}} on {{app:nav.today}}: the {{app:home.tools.kicks}} opens. (A Pro tool.)
guide.pregnant.step3: In labour, + → {{app:home.tools.contractions}} times each contraction. (A Pro tool.)
guide.pregnant.step5: When your baby is born: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:me.born}}. Bloom turns to the newborn months, and everything you logged comes with you.
guide.pregnant.good: If you feel fewer movements than usual, or they slow down or stop, call your midwife or maternity unit straight away, any hour. You will not be wasting anyone's time.
guide.pregnant.shotAlt: Today in pregnancy: the week, the baby's size and today's logs
guide.newborn.title: {{app:mode.newborn}}
guide.newborn.for: Feeds, sleep and diapers in one tap — even at 3am. Pumping by side, and the milk you have in the fridge and the freezer.
guide.newborn.step1: When a feed starts, tap {{app:n3.feed}} and choose {{app:nb.feed.left}}, {{app:nb.feed.right}} or {{app:nb.feed.bottle}}.
guide.newborn.step2: {{app:n3.sleep}} starts the sleep timer; tap {{app:n3.wake}} when your baby wakes.
guide.newborn.step4: {{app:nb.tile.pump}} times pumping by side — {{app:nb.feed.left}}, {{app:nb.feed.right}} or {{app:be.both}} — and keeps how much you pumped.
guide.newborn.step5: {{app:milk.title}} shows the milk in the {{app:milk.fridge}} and the {{app:milk.freezer}}.
guide.newborn.step6: At night: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:me.night}} dims Bloom for one-handed feeds.
guide.newborn.shotAlt: Today with a newborn: the baby asleep, with feed, diaper and pumping one tap away
guide.peri.title: {{app:mode.peri}}
guide.peri.for: Symptoms, hot flushes and cycle changes over time, so you can see your own pattern — and bring it to your doctor.
guide.peri.step1: Each time a flush comes, tap + → {{app:peri.tile.flashes}}.
guide.peri.step2: Log the rest of your day the same way: {{app:plus.symptoms}} and {{app:log.tile.mood}}.
guide.peri.step3: If you still have periods, + → {{app:cyc.log.start}} when one begins.
guide.peri.step5: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.summary}} makes a private summary to show your doctor.
guide.peri.shotAlt: Today in menopause: today's symptoms, flushes and mood
guide.ask.title: Ask Bloom
guide.ask.for: Write to Bloom, or call her and talk. She answers in plain words, remembers what you have told her, and says when something needs your doctor or midwife.
guide.ask.where: The round button at the top right ({{app:orb.label}})
guide.ask.step1: Tap the round button at the top right. Write your question and tap the arrow ({{app:ask.send}}) — or tap one of the questions Bloom suggests.
guide.ask.step2: To talk instead, tap {{app:call.cta}} and speak as you would to a friend. Tap {{app:call.end}} when you are done.
guide.ask.step3: {{app:voice.read}} has Bloom read her answers out loud.
guide.ask.step4: Bloom remembers what you share — your people, your dates — so you don't start again each time. To clear it: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.privacy}} → {{app:privacy.aiforget}}.
guide.ask.step5: In calls, Bloom learns to tell voices apart, so she can greet your people by name. The voices stay on your phone: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.privacy}} → {{app:voices.row}}.
guide.ask.good: Bloom's answers are general information, not medical advice. {{{ask.flow}}}
guide.ask.shotAlt: Ask Bloom in the app: a question about the baby's movements and Bloom's answer
guide.family.title: Family
guide.family.for: Bloom is yours, and your people can be part of it: your circle, the baby pool, letters for your baby and your book.
guide.family.step1: {{app:nav.us}} shows your circle: your partner and the people you add.
guide.family.step2: {{app:menu.partner}} sends a short update to the people you choose — only what you choose, only when you send it.
guide.family.step3: In pregnancy, the baby pool: {{app:us.pool.first}} (later {{app:us.pool.open}}), then {{app:us.pool.share}}; add each guess of the day and the weight as it comes back.
guide.family.step4: Write letters to your baby and seal each one until the day you choose.
guide.family.step5: {{app:us.book.title}}: Bloom writes your book as you go — the weeks, what you logged, your letters, the pool. It stays on your phone.
guide.family.step6: To invite a friend: {{app:nav.us}} → the + at the end of your circle ({{app:menu.invite}}) → {{app:invite.share}}. A friend who already has Bloom enters your code in the same place, under {{app:invite.have}}, and taps {{app:invite.redeem}}.
guide.family.shotAlt: Us in the app: the circle and the baby pool with the family's guesses
guide.privacy.title: {{app:menu.privacy}}
guide.privacy.for: Your days stay on your phone. Here you take them with you, wipe them, and decide what Bloom keeps.
guide.privacy.step1: {{app:privacy.export}} saves everything you have logged as one file.
guide.privacy.step2: {{app:privacy.delete}} erases it all from this phone. There is no undo.
guide.privacy.step3: {{app:privacy.aiforget}} clears what Bloom has learned about you; {{app:voices.row}} lets you forget the voices she knows.
guide.privacy.step4: {{app:membk.row.off}}: if you say {{app:membk.yes}}, a copy of Bloom's memory note — only that note — is kept on Bloom's server, so a new phone still remembers you. Turn it off and the copy is deleted.
guide.privacy.step5: {{app:lock.row.off}} sets a 4-digit PIN that Bloom asks for each time it opens.
guide.privacy.step6: {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.summary}} makes a private summary to show your doctor or midwife.
guide.privacy.good: What leaves your phone, when, and why: {{guide.privacy.link}}.
guide.privacy.shotAlt: Privacy and data in the app: export, forget, voices, the memory backup, app lock and delete
guide.pro.title: Pro
guide.pro.for: Bloom is free to use. Pro is one payment, yours for life: the full week-by-week journey, the kick counter and the contraction timer, and the Pro tools that come later.
guide.pro.step1: Tap {{app:nav.me}} → {{app:menu.pro}} — or {{app:pro.locked.cta}} on a Pro tool ({{app:pro.locked.title}}).
guide.pro.step2: Your store's own payment sheet opens — the App Store or Google Play — and the store shows the price where you live. Bloom never sees your card.
guide.pro.step3: When the store confirms it, Pro is yours, and the Pro tools open.
guide.pro.step4: After a reinstall, Pro usually comes back by itself. If it does not, write to us with the store's receipt and we will put it right.
guide.pro.shotAlt: The kick counter, one of the Pro tools, open in the app
